## At a glance

- **Covers.** [[Session 2 - Recap]]: the early bell, the fight under the boards and the climb to the Drowned Chapel.
- **Ends on.** The groan of Crookback Sluice, rolling in from the east.
- **Leads into.** The next Session's Prep, which is not yet written.

> [!narration] Previously on
> A week after the lamp was lit, the bell rang again, and the water fell away from under Reedholt. Nib Ashwater showed you the tally-sticks of the drowned, and told you where the ledger lay. You crossed the mud with two grey hands trying to drag you under. In the chapel tower you met Sable, the last bell-ringer of Vessen. Odalys spoke the names of the dead, and Sable gave her the book. Goblins climbed the stair behind you, and Brannoch held them off. You read the marked page in the tally house. It said the Compact was the hand that opened the sluice, and it was signed with the name Tarrow. Outside, the tide came back, and from far off came a long, low groan.
